title: The Forgotten War
summary: Descending like a thunderbolt, Ha-Jun duels Demon King Malgath in single combat before the paralyzed 300,000-demon armada, testing the limits of the Eclipse Devourer.

panels.shot: supersonic dive from 15,000 feet wide shot
panels.action: Ha-Jun streaks downward like a falling violet comet, breaking multiple sound barriers.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun streaks downward like a falling violet comet, breaking multiple sound barriers.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ek girte hue baingani dhumketu ki tarah kai dhwani avrodhon ko todte hue neeche ki or badhta hai.

panels.shot: demon king malgath roaring as he breaks free from gravity
panels.action: Channeling ancient demonic rage, Malgath forces himself to his feet, swinging his 8-ton war hammer upward.
panels.prose_en: Channeling ancient demonic rage, Malgath forces himself to his feet, swinging his 8-ton war hammer upward.
panels.prose_hi: Prachin shaitani demonic krodh ko bharakaate hue, Malgath apne pairon par khada ho jata hai aur apne 8-tan ke yudh hathaude ko upar ki or ghumata hai.

panels.shot: titan clash of meteor dive and war hammer
panels.action: Ha-Jun's descending Eclipse Devourer strikes Malgath's war hammer dead-center; a 500-meter crater tears open.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's descending Eclipse Devourer strikes Malgath's war hammer dead-center; a 500-meter crater tears open.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ka utarta hua aclips davoorer Malgath ke yudh hathaude ke mrit-kendra par hamla karta hai; 500 meter ka gaddha khul gaya.

panels.shot: shockwave blasting 10,000 demon soldiers across the plains
panels.action: The kinetic shockwave blows surrounding demon infantry into the air like dry autumn leaves.
panels.prose_en: The kinetic shockwave blows surrounding demon infantry into the air like dry autumn leaves.
panels.prose_hi: Gatij shockwev sukhi sharad ritu ke patton ki tarah charon or rakshas paidal sena ko hawa mein uda deti hai.

panels.shot: dust clearing to reveal the two monarchs locked in weapon clash
panels.action: In the center of the smoking crater: Ha-Jun's two-handed sword pressuring Malgath's massive iron hammer.
panels.prose_en: In the center of the smoking crater: Ha-Jun's two-handed sword pressuring Malgath's massive iron hammer.
panels.prose_hi: Dhumrapan crator ke kendra men: Ha-Jun ki do haath wali talwar Malgath ke vishal lohe ke hathaude par dabav daal rahi hai.

panels.shot: malgath four yellow eyes bulging in disbelief
panels.action: Malgath grinds his tusks: 'A boy holding back my World-Shattering Hammer with one blade?!'

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: Yeh taaqat insaani muscles se nahi aa sakti! Who are you?!

panels.prose_en: Malgath grinds his tusks: 'A boy holding back my World-Shattering Hammer with one blade?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath apne daant pista hai: 'ek ladka mere vishv-vidhwansak hathaude ko ek blade se pakad raha hai?!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun dual-ringed eyes glowing with cosmic calm
panels.action: Ha-Jun's expression is frozen in tranquil majesty: 'I already told you. The True Sovereign.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aur yeh blade sirf sword nahi hai... Yeh devourer hai.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's expression is frozen in tranquil majesty: 'I already told you. The True Sovereign.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki abhivyakti shant mahima mein sthir hai: 'maine aapko pehle hi bataya tha. sachcha samprabhu.'

panels.shot: eclipse devourer activating mana absorption authority
panels.action: The black longsword begins drinking in Malgath's dark mana; the hammer's red runes flicker and dim.
panels.prose_en: The black longsword begins drinking in Malgath's dark mana; the hammer's red runes flicker and dim.
panels.prose_hi: Black longsward Malgath ke andhere maina mein peena shuru kar deta hai; hathaude ki lal kiranen timtimati aur dhundhli ho jaati han.

panels.shot: malgath feeling his life force and mana siphoned
panels.action: Malgath gasps as immense rivers of his demonic strength are forcibly sucked into Ha-Jun's blade.

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: Mera mana... Yeh talwar mera mana pee rahi hai?! Stop!!

panels.prose_en: Malgath gasps as immense rivers of his demonic strength are forcibly sucked into Ha-Jun's blade.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath hanefane lagta hai kyonki uski shaitani taqat ki vishal nadiyan jabran Ha-Jun ke blade mein sama jaati han.

panels.shot: ha-jun pivoting with fluid martial precision
panels.action: Ha-Jun smoothly steps off the line of force, redirecting Malgath's momentum into the earth.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun smoothly steps off the line of force, redirecting Malgath's momentum into the earth.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun aasani se bal ki rekha se hat jata hai, aur Malgath ki gati ko prithvi mein punarnirdeshit karta hai.

panels.shot: malgath stumbling forward off-balance
panels.action: The 20-foot colossus stumbles forward awkwardly, his 8-ton hammer slamming into empty mud.
panels.prose_en: The 20-foot colossus stumbles forward awkwardly, his 8-ton hammer slamming into empty mud.
panels.prose_hi: 20 foot ka vishalkay vyakti ajeeb tarike se aage ki or ladkhadata hai, uska 8 ton ka hathauda khali mitti mein gir jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun executing spinning heel kick to malgath jaw
panels.action: Ha-Jun spins in midair; his left bone gauntlet-reinforced boot strikes Malgath's chin like a cannon.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun spins in midair; his left bone gauntlet-reinforced boot strikes Malgath's chin like a cannon.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun hawa mein ghumta hai; uska bayan haddi wala gauntlet-prablit boot Malgath ki thuddi par top ki tarah prahar karta hai.

panels.shot: malgath massive iron helmet denting inward
panels.action: The reinforced iron horned helmet buckles; Malgath's head snaps back, spitting black blood and shattered tusks.
panels.prose_en: The reinforced iron horned helmet buckles; Malgath's head snaps back, spitting black blood and shattered tusks.
panels.prose_hi: Prablit lohe ke seeng wale helmet bakal; Malgath ka sir peeche ki or mud jata hai, jisse kala khoon aur toote hue daant ugalte han.

panels.shot: malgath reeling backward three colossal steps
panels.action: The demon king staggers backward, groaning as the earth trembles beneath his heavy boots.
panels.prose_en: The demon king staggers backward, groaning as the earth trembles beneath his heavy boots.
panels.prose_hi: Rakshs raja karahate hue peeche ki or ladkhadata hai aur uske bhari jooton ke neeche se dharti kampati hai.

panels.shot: malgath raising hammer in two hands for ultimate spell
panels.action: Enraged, Malgath channels his final ancestral spell: 'EARTH-BREAKER TITAN FLARE!'
panels.prose_en: Enraged, Malgath channels his final ancestral spell: 'EARTH-BREAKER TITAN FLARE!'.
panels.prose_hi: Crodhit hokar, Malgath ne apna antim patrik mantra prasarit kiya: 'arth-braker titan flar!'.

panels.shot: the ground splitting into rivers of molten lava
panels.action: Fissures of boiling subterranean magma erupt across the crater, ready to incinerate Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_en: Fissures of boiling subterranean magma erupt across the crater, ready to incinerate Ha-Jun.
panels.prose_hi: Ubalte hue bhumigat magma ki dararen crator mein foot padti han, jo Ha-Jun ko bhasm karne ke liye taiyar hoti han.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing motionless holding eclipse devourer aloft
panels.action: Ha-Jun raises the black greatsword with both hands, pointing the blade at the stormy sky.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun raises the black greatsword with both hands, pointing the blade at the stormy sky.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun donon hathon se kali talwar uthata hai aur blade ko toofani aakash ki or ingit karta hai.

panels.shot: the devourer blade unleashing a black gravitational vortex
panels.action: At the sword tip, a miniature black hole of pure dark matter expands, sucking in light and sound.
panels.prose_en: At the sword tip, a miniature black hole of pure dark matter expands, sucking in light and sound.
panels.prose_hi: Talwar ki nok par, shuddh kale padarth ka ek chhota black hole failta hai, jo prakash aur dhwani ko sokh leta hai.

panels.shot: all erupting lava geysers sucked into the black vortex
panels.action: Every river of molten lava and spellfire is vacuumed directly into the singularity on Ha-Jun's blade.
panels.prose_en: Every river of molten lava and spellfire is vacuumed directly into the singularity on Ha-Jun's blade.
panels.prose_hi: Pighle hue lava aur jadu ki aag ki pratyek nadi ko sidhe Ha-Jun ke blade par vilakshanta mein nirvaat kiya jata hai.

panels.shot: crater left completely frozen and dark
panels.action: Not a single drop of fire remains; the ground is left cold, dark, and utterly silenced.

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: Mera 8th-Tier spell... Gayab ho gaya?! He swallowed an entire volcanic eruption?!

panels.prose_en: Not a single drop of fire remains; the ground is left cold, dark, and utterly silenced.
panels.prose_hi: Aag ki ek boond bhi nahin bachi; zameen thandi, andheri aur puri tarah se khamosh chhod di gai hai.

panels.shot: eclipse devourer pulsing with stored absorbed mana
panels.action: The jet-black blade now blazes with absorbed crimson magma veins: stored kinetic payload.
panels.prose_en: The jet-black blade now blazes with absorbed crimson magma veins: stored kinetic payload.
panels.prose_hi: Jet-kala blade ab avshoshit crimson magma nason ke saath chamakta hai: sangrahit gatij pelod.

panels.shot: ha-jun bringing blade down in a clean diagonal stroke
panels.action: Ha-Jun releases the stored payload in a single, devastating crescent wave of black-and-crimson energy.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun releases the stored payload in a single, devastating crescent wave of black-and-crimson energy.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun sangrahit payload ko kali aur lal rang ki urja ki ekal, vinashkari ardhchandrakar tarang mein chhodta hai.

panels.shot: wave of energy slicing malgath 8-ton war hammer in two
panels.action: The crescent beam strikes Malgath's legendary war hammer, shearing through solid meteor iron like paper.
panels.prose_en: The crescent beam strikes Malgath's legendary war hammer, shearing through solid meteor iron like paper.
panels.prose_hi: Ardhchandrakar kiran Malgath ke prasiddh yudh hathaude se takrati hai, aur thos ulkapind ko kagaj ki tarah kaatati hai.

panels.shot: hammer head crashing to earth in two smoking halves
panels.action: The two severed halves of the eight-ton hammer fall into the dirt with heavy, hollow thuds.
panels.prose_en: The two severed halves of the eight-ton hammer fall into the dirt with heavy, hollow thuds.
panels.prose_hi: Aath ton ke hathaude ke do kate hue hisse bhari, khokhale gadgdahat ke saath mitti mein gir jaate han.

panels.shot: crescent wave slicing across malgath iron chestplate
panels.action: The edge of the beam cleanly severs Malgath's thick chestplate, carving a deep, smoking wound across his ribs.
panels.prose_en: The edge of the beam cleanly severs Malgath's thick chestplate, carving a deep, smoking wound across his ribs.
panels.prose_hi: Bim ka kinara Malgath ki moti chestaplate ko saf-saf kaat deta hai, jisse uski pasliyon par ek gahra, dhuandar ghav ban jata hai.

panels.shot: demon king malgath falling to both knees
panels.action: The 20-foot demon colossus drops to his knees in the crater, gasping as black blood pours from his chest.

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: I... I yield... Thou art the true heir of Asmodaius...

panels.prose_en: The 20-foot demon colossus drops to his knees in the crater, gasping as black blood pours from his chest.
panels.prose_hi: 20 foot ka danav vishalkay vyakti gaddhe mein ghutnon ke bal gir jata hai aur hanfne lagta hai kyonki uski chhati se kala khoon bah raha hota hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun lowering eclipse devourer to malgath throat
panels.action: Ha-Jun rests the flat of the black blade gently against Malgath's neck: 'Main tumhari jaan nahi loonga.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Apni army ko withdraw karo. Aur agar Void ke parasites se azaad hona chahte ho... Toh mere sath aao.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun rests the flat of the black blade gently against Malgath's neck: 'Main tumhari jaan nahi loonga.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne kali blade ko dheere se Malgath ki gardan par tikaya: 'main tumhari jaan nahin lunga.'

panels.shot: malgath looking up in tears of ancestral shame and relief
panels.action: Malgath bows his massive horned head to the earth, touching the dirt before Ha-Jun's boots.

dialogue.speaker: malgath
dialogue.text: My life... and my legions belong to you, My Sovereign.

panels.prose_en: Malgath bows his massive horned head to the earth, touching the dirt before Ha-Jun's boots.
panels.prose_hi: Malgath apne vishal seeng wale sir ko dharti par jhukata hai, Ha-Jun ke jooton ke samne mitti ko chhuta hai.

panels.shot: entire 300,000 army erupting in earth-shattering battle cry
panels.action: Seeing their king pledge fealty, the three hundred thousand demon soldiers raise their spears in thunderous praise.
panels.prose_en: Seeing their king pledge fealty, the three hundred thousand demon soldiers raise their spears in thunderous praise.
panels.prose_hi: Apne raja ko nishtha ki pratigya karte dekh, teen lakh rakshas sainik gadgdahat ke saath apne bhale uthate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing victorious atop the crater rim
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands tall, Crown gleaming, Eclipse Devourer resting on his shoulder as the army bows before him.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: One Demon King defeated... Two more to go.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun stands tall, Crown gleaming, Eclipse Devourer resting on his shoulder as the army bows before him.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun lamba khada hai, uska mukut chamak raha hai, aclips davoorer uske kandhe par aaram kar raha hai aur sena uske samne jhuk rahi hai.
